set system host-name DeviceC.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment used to identify the equipment in the network.

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.20.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

set protocols bgp group IBGP type intern.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP type internal
set protocols bgp group IBGP type intern.explanation: Configure BGP protocol group with specified type

parameters.name: group name
parameters.explanation: Name of the BGP group

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of the BGP group, e.g., internal or external

set protocols bgp group IBGP local-addre.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP local-address 10.20.1.1
set protocols bgp group IBGP local-addre.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings specifying the group and local address

parameters.name: group name
parameters.explanation: Name of the BGP group

parameters.name: local address
parameters.explanation: Local IP address for BGP peering

set protocols bgp group IBGP neighbor 10.template: set protocols bgp group [group_name] neighbor [neighbor_ip] peer-as [as_number]
set protocols bgp group IBGP neighbor 10.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP neighbor 10.20.1.2 peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group IBGP neighbor 10.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings by specifying the group name, neighbor IP address, and the autonomous system (AS) number for the peer.

parameters.name: group_name
parameters.explanation: The name of the BGP group.

parameters.name: neighbor_ip
parameters.explanation: The IP address of the BGP neighbor.

parameters.name: as_number
parameters.explanation: The autonomous system number of the BGP peer.

set protocols bgp group IBGP family inet.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP family inet unicast
set protocols bgp group IBGP family inet.explanation: Configure BGP protocol settings for a specific group and address family

parameters.name: group name
parameters.explanation: Name of the BGP group

parameters.name: address family
parameters.explanation: Type of address family (e.g., inet)

parameters.name: sub-address family
parameters.explanation: Type of sub-address family (e.g., unicast)

set protocols bgp group IBGP export redi.command: set protocols bgp group IBGP export redistribute-connected
set protocols bgp group IBGP export redi.explanation: Configure BGP protocol to export routes from a specified group

parameters.name: group name
parameters.explanation: Name of the BGP group

parameters.name: export policy
parameters.explanation: Policy for exporting routes, e.g., redistribute-connected

set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.command: set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-1/0/0.0
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interfac.explanation: Configure OSPF protocol area and interface

parameters.name: OSPF area
parameters.explanation: The OSPF area identifier in IPv4 address format

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be included in the OSPF area

set policy-options policy-statement redi.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: Configure a policy statement to redistribute connected routes with a specific term and protocol

parameters.name: policy-statement name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.explanation: The protocol from which routes are to be redistributed

set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 then accept
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: Configures a policy statement to redistribute connected routes under a specific term with an action to accept them.

parameters.name: policy-statement name
parameters.explanation: The name of the policy statement.

parameters.name: term number
parameters.explanation: The term number within the policy statement.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken (e.g., accept, reject).

set routing-options autonomous-system 10.explanation: Configure the autonomous system number for routing options

parameters.name: autonomous-system number
parameters.explanation: The autonomous system number
